name: Octus
one_liner: Octus provides credit market news, covenant analysis, and legal document tools for professionals working in sub-investment grade debt.
what_you_sell: A credit market intelligence, data, and document management platform covering leveraged loans, high-yield bonds, private credit, and bankruptcy restructurings.
target_group: Octus sells to buy-side investment firms, investment banks, law firms, and advisory practices involved in sub-investment grade credit. Good prospects actively manage, advise on, or litigate leveraged loans, private credit, high-yield bonds, or Chapter 11 bankruptcies. Bad prospects are consumer finance companies, equity-focused investment funds, or general corporate legal teams without dedicated credit practices.
who_uses_it: Credit analysts, financial analysts, legal analysts, portfolio managers, investment bankers, and restructuring attorneys.
who_pays_for_it: Asset management firms, investment banks, corporate law firms, and financial advisory firms.
who_buys_it: Institutional buy-side asset managers, investment banks, corporate law firms, and financial advisory practices operating in credit markets.
_claims_to_check: Claims 100% of the top 10 asset managers and CLO managers are clients.
Claims to have over 44,000 global subscribers.
Claims to host a repository of over 11 million deal documents covering 28,000 issuers.
Claims to publish over 60,000 stories globally every year.
Implies direct, permissioned integration capabilities with Harvey AI, Perplexity, and Claude.
